title: The Lost Flock
description: A Millbrook shepherd's flock scattered when dire wolves hit them near Willow Dale, and the sheep are the whole of what he owns - no wool to sell, no mutton for winter, no flock to breed back from if they're gone for good. As a servant of Gaela, protector of pastoral life, you are asked to find them before the wolves do.

objectives.description: Find the shepherd's lost sheep near Willow Dale
Kill the Dire Wolves threatening the flock
Escort the sheep safely back to Millbrook
Return to the Shepherd in Millbrook

notes: Threat: the shepherd's entire livelihood, named explicitly rather than left as an unstated assumption. Giver motive: he has no militia and no coin to hire a hunter, only a stranger passing through Millbrook. Consequence: not wired; losing the flock for good is stated as ruin, not enforced.
